proposals.expected_signal: If current gains rely on popularity leakage rather than robust preference structure, replacing uniform negatives with sampled unobserved negatives biased toward high-degree items should sharply reduce
proposals.failure_mode: Training may over-focus on globally popular unobserved items, collapsing personalization and hurting tail-user ranking without yielding a clean discriminative gap.
proposals.hypothesis: If the incumbent hypothesis is fragile, a light graph model trained with degree-tempered hard negatives will expose it by preserving optimization ease while removing the benignity of uniform negatives; true robust mechanisms should retain most NDCG@10, while spurious popularity-driven gains should fall materially.
